thermostat_not_accepting.title: {thermostat} does not take its setpoint
thermostat_not_accepting.description:
HeatManager asked **{thermostat}** (`{entity_id}`, room {room}) four times over about 13 minutes to heat to {temperature} °C, but it keeps reporting a different setpoint.

Check the device: batteries, radio connection, child lock, or an internal schedule/auto mode that overrides commands. The warning disappears as soon as the thermostat takes a setpoint again.

thermostat_unavailable.title: {thermostat} has been unavailable for over an hour
thermostat_unavailable.description:
**{thermostat}** (`{entity_id}`, room {room}) has been unavailable for more than an hour, so HeatManager cannot control it.

Check batteries and the radio connection. The warning disappears as soon as the thermostat is back.
